description:
If your family has ever argued gold versus property, these numbers are worth knowing.

In 2010, 10 grams of 24K gold cost about ₹18,500. On 16 November 2026 it was about ₹1,36,950 in Delhi, roughly seven times more. Yet the same week it fell ₹1,690 over one weekend. Property is not as steady as people think either: RBI's house price index for 18 cities fell 0.6% between July and September 2025, and in its latest reading it is up 3.6% over a year. A flat can bring rent or save you rent, while gold sits in the locker; gold can be sold in minutes, a flat takes months and stamp duty.

In your home, who is on team gold and who is on team property?

(Sources: RBI House Price Index, BankBazaar and Goodreturns gold rates. Some scenes are AI visualisation. For education only.)
